name: Grandma's Whitebait Shop
about: A proposed layout for the user's approval before the level is built (docs/LEARNINGS.md A8): the photographic KM2-3_grandmas_whitebait_shop.png, face-on, at 215 px to the metre about the shop's middle (x = 0), its frontage laid along the beach road as the picture has it. A mini-game leg (docs/CITIES.md M2, the errand): the kid comes up the steps from the beach (KM2-2 stops there), wraps the bento with Grandma at her counter, and goes on along the promenade to the sand (KM2-4). Game axes: x along the lane (m), z away from the camera (the play lane at z = 0), front: the z of a model's street face.
